summary.zh-Hans: 伦敦塔桥的高层步道连接南北两座桥塔，可以从高处眺望泰晤士河和伦敦。桥面中段可开启，让船只通过。
summary.en: Tower Bridge has high-level walkways linking its north and south towers, with views over the Thames and London. Its central road sections can rise to let vessels pass.

summary.zh-Hans: 邱园始建于1759年，收藏活体植物、植物标本和文献。园内的棕榈温室与温带温室是其历史景观的一部分。
summary.en: Founded in 1759, Kew holds collections of living plants, preserved specimens and documents. The Palm House and Temperate House form part of its historic garden landscape.

summary.zh-Hans: 炸鱼薯条把裹面糊炸制的鱼与薯条搭配。在伦敦的传统炸鱼店和餐馆都能尝到这道菜。
summary.en: Fish and chips pairs battered, fried fish with chips. London serves it in traditional fish-and-chip shops as well as restaurants.

summary.zh-Hans: 伦敦的传统下午茶常把茶、手指三明治、小蛋糕，以及配奶油和果酱的司康一起供应。各店的内容可以不同。
summary.en: A traditional London afternoon tea can bring together tea, finger sandwiches, small cakes and scones with cream and jam. The selection varies by venue.
